journey.name: cancel primary force close
journey.description: Requires an open regtest channel to the selected primary. This journey checks cancellation only and must leave the channel open. The UI confirmation also has an instrumented test. This Android primary-node flow is not implemented on iOS yet.

actions.action: Open Settings, Advanced, Lightning Connections and select the primary channel
Open Close Connection and tap Force close connection (testTag "ForceCloseConnection")
Verify the confirmation describes the Bitcoin network fee and the possible period before funds become available
Tap Cancel (testTag "ForceCloseCancel") and verify the confirmation closes without starting a channel closure
Return to Lightning Connections and verify the same channel remains open
